title: Quick Tony thoughts! What a night! JUSTICE FOR ADAM FISHER #tonyawards
transcript: Quick Tony thoughts as I carry this cake across New York, but overall I really loved the ceremony. A lot of surprises, a lot of highs and lows. There were definitely some categories I didn't love, like both of the revivals, but I kinda was braced for it. Overall, however, I am elated. Like screaming in the bar elated with Shoshanna and Ali winning for Lost Boys. So well deserved. Fantastic, fantastic speeches from both of them. And I love that we got got wins from both Casey Levy and Shoshana Bean. I need them to duet wild with their Tonys like immediately. Just throwing that into the universe. And I am so, so happy that we got wins for both Zhailon Levingston and Bill Rauch. And Qween Jean. Qween Jean’s was in the pre ceremony in Act 1, but she gave a fantastic speech. Please go watch it. A huge congrats to Schmigadoon for winning Big tonight with all of the writing categories and Best Musical. I do think it's very well deserved. It's a great, really fun show. I hope this means they green light season 3 cause I need into the Schmoods immediately. I am a little sad that we didn't get any wins for two strangers carry a cake across New York, but they did have, in my opinion, one of the best performances of The night. So much fun. And I think it sold the show really, really well. I hope people go see it. It's such a fantastic musical. And that opening number, maybe the best opening number we've seen at the Tony Awards since 2013. That was fantastic. Agree. And overall, I thought pink was a great host. Pink on Broadway when? Yeah, pink in Chicago. Did they soft launch that? Considering she literally performed in their Chicago performance. Anyway, overall a fantastic ceremony. I cannot wait to do this again next year and. And just, you know, obviously we have wanted next year, but if it ends up being wanted and Paddington and Warriors and, I don't know, Benjamin Button, it's gonna be an insane year.
classificationReason: Reactions to the Tony Awards ceremony covering multiple shows (The Lost Boys, Schmigadoon, Two Strangers, Liberation, etc.). No single show is the primary focus; this is a multi-show roundup of Tony night reactions.
